title: 多益模擬：聽力（原創）
note: 本站原創的多益風格聽力模擬題，不是 ETS 的正式試題。聲音是你的手機或電腦內建的語音唸的，每台裝置聽起來不一樣；第二大題的三個回應只用唸的，畫面上只有 A／B／C。

source.name: 彰師電子小黑貓 原創模擬題
source.license: 本站自行編寫的原創題目，與 ETS 無關；TOEIC、TOEFL 為 ETS 的註冊商標，本題庫不含任何正式試題

t3_print.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_print.say:
W: Hi, Marcus. The printer on our floor keeps jamming, and I have to print forty copies of the sales presentation for tomorrow morning's meeting.
M: Oh no. The technician isn't coming until Thursday. Why don't you use the printer in the marketing department on the fifth floor? It's usually free in the afternoon.
W: Good idea. But I'll need a key card to get into their office, won't I?
M: That's right. I'll call Jenny in marketing and ask her to let you in. Just give me a minute.

t3_hotel.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_hotel.say:
M: Good afternoon, Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
W: Hello, I have a reservation for three nights starting on the twelfth, under the name Rivera. I'd like to know if I can change it to start on the eleventh instead.
M: Let me check. Yes, we have a room available on the eleventh. However, it's a standard room, not an ocean-view room like the one you booked. Would that be all right for the first night?
W: That's fine. And could you arrange an airport pickup for me? My flight lands at six in the evening.
M: Certainly. There's a twenty-dollar charge for that service, which will be added to your bill.

t3_launch.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_launch.say:
W: Kevin, how are the preparations for the product launch going?
M: Mostly fine, but the brochures from the printing company haven't arrived yet. They were supposed to be here yesterday.
W: That's a problem. The launch event is on Friday, and we want to hand them out to every guest.
M: I know. I called the printer this morning, and they said one of their delivery trucks broke down. They promised to send the brochures by express courier tomorrow.
W: All right. But just in case, could you prepare a digital version we could show on the screens at the event?
M: Sure. I'll ask the design team to set that up today.

t3_gym.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_gym.say:
M: Hi, I'm interested in joining this fitness center. Could you tell me about your membership options?
W: Sure. We have a monthly plan for forty-five dollars and an annual plan for four hundred and twenty dollars. The annual plan also includes two free sessions with a personal trainer.
M: The annual plan sounds like a better deal, but I'm moving to another city for work in about six months.
W: In that case, you might like our six-month plan. It's two hundred and forty dollars, and you can cancel any time after the first three months.
M: That sounds perfect. Can I sign up now?
W: Of course. I'll just need to see a photo ID.

t3_veg.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_veg.say:
W: Hi, this is Ana from Green Leaf Café. I'm calling about the vegetables we received this morning. Half of the tomatoes were damaged.
M: I'm very sorry about that, Ana. Our driver mentioned that the cooling system in the delivery van wasn't working properly today.
W: I see. The thing is, we need those tomatoes for our lunch special, which starts at eleven thirty.
M: I understand. I can have a new box sent over within the hour, and of course we won't charge you for the damaged ones.
W: Thank you. That would really help.

t3_interview.text:
Part 3 — Conversation
Listen to the conversation, then answer the questions.
t3_interview.say:
M: Hello, is this Ms. Tanaka? This is Robert Hill from Lakeside Engineering. We received your application for the project coordinator position, and we'd like to invite you for an interview.
W: Oh, that's wonderful news. Thank you for calling.
M: Would you be available next Tuesday at ten a.m.?
W: Unfortunately, I have a final exam that morning. Would Wednesday work instead?
M: Wednesday afternoon is possible. How about two o'clock? And please bring some examples of projects you've managed in the past.
W: Two o'clock is fine. I'll bring my portfolio.

t4_tour.text:
Part 4 — Talk
Listen to the talk, then answer the questions.
t4_tour.say: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Chocolate Factory tour. My name is Grace, and I'll be your guide today. The tour will last about ninety minutes. First, we'll watch a short video about the history of the company, which was founded in 1952. After that, we'll walk through the production area, where you can see how our chocolate bars are made. Please note that taking photographs inside the production area is not permitted. At the end of the tour, everyone will receive a free sample, and you'll have a chance to visit our gift shop, where all products are fifteen percent off today.

t4_dental.text:
Part 4 — Talk
Listen to the talk, then answer the questions.
t4_dental.say: Hi, Mr. Duncan. This is Sarah Collins from Bright Dental Clinic, calling to remind you about your appointment with Dr. Evans this Thursday at three fifteen. We've recently moved to a new location at 240 Elm Street, next to the public library, so please make sure you come to the new address. Parking is available behind the building. If you need to reschedule, please call us at least twenty-four hours in advance. Otherwise, a cancellation fee may apply. Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.

t4_flight.text:
Part 4 — Talk
Listen to the talk, then answer the questions.
t4_flight.say: Attention, passengers on Coastline Airways flight 508 to Vancouver. Due to heavy fog at Vancouver International Airport, this flight has been delayed. The new departure time is four forty p.m. We apologize for the inconvenience. Passengers on this flight may pick up a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars at the customer service counter near Gate 22. The voucher can be used at any restaurant in Terminal B. We will make another announcement when boarding begins. Thank you for your patience.

t4_expense.text:
Part 4 — Talk
Listen to the talk, then answer the questions.
t4_expense.say: Before we finish today's meeting, I have one more announcement. Starting next month, our company will introduce a new online system for submitting travel expenses. Instead of filling out paper forms, you'll upload photos of your receipts directly from your phone. This should make the process much faster. Reimbursements will be paid within five business days instead of three weeks. To help everyone get used to the system, the accounting department is holding a training session next Wednesday at two p.m. in the main conference room. Attendance is required for anyone who travels for work, so please add it to your calendar.

t4_traffic.text:
Part 4 — Talk
Listen to the talk, then answer the questions.
t4_traffic.say: You're listening to KTR Radio's morning traffic report. If you're driving downtown, expect delays on Main Street, where one lane is closed for road repairs between Fifth and Ninth Avenue. The work is expected to continue until Friday. Drivers are encouraged to use Park Avenue instead. In other news, the city's annual food festival begins this Saturday at Lakeside Park. Because large crowds are expected, organizers recommend taking the free shuttle bus from City Hall. Now, here's Tom with the weather.

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Where should I put these boxes?
M: A. Yes, I bought them yesterday. B. In the storage room, please. C. About twenty of them.

explain.text: 問「放哪裡」，(B) 回答地點。(A) 用 Yes 回答 Wh- 問句是陷阱；(C) 回答數量。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: When does the training session start?
W: A. In Conference Room B. B. Mr. Patel is leading it. C. Right after lunch.

explain.text: 問「什麼時候」，(C) 回答時間。(A) 是地點、(B) 是人。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Who's responsible for ordering office supplies?
M: A. Linda in the front office handles that. B. Some paper and printer ink. C. It was delivered on Monday.

explain.text: 問「誰負責」，(A) 給了人名。(B) 是買什麼、(C) 是什麼時候送到。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: Why was the flight to Chicago delayed?
W: A. Gate twelve, I think. B. Because of a storm in the area. C. It's about three hours long.

explain.text: 問「為什麼」，(B) 用 Because 給原因。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Would you like me to print the report for you?
M: A. That would be great, thanks. B. The printer on the third floor. C. He reported it yesterday.

explain.text: 對方主動提議幫忙，(A) 接受並道謝。(C) 用 report／reported 同音字當陷阱。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: How often do you check your e-mail?
W: A. At the post office. B. I sent it this morning. C. Several times a day.

explain.text: How often 問頻率，(C) 回答「一天好幾次」。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: The new copier is much faster than the old one.
M: A. Yes, it saves us a lot of time. B. Ten copies, please. C. I'll be there in a minute.

explain.text: 直述句表達意見，(A) 表示同意並補充。(B) 用 copier／copies 相近字當陷阱。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: Haven't you finished the budget proposal yet?
W: A. The budget is too small. B. I'm still waiting for the sales figures. C. Yes, I proposed it.

explain.text: 問「還沒做完嗎」，(B) 用「還在等數字」間接說明還沒完成——多益很愛這種不直接說 Yes／No 的答法。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Should we take a taxi or walk to the restaurant?
M: A. It's only five minutes on foot. B. The pasta is excellent there. C. He's a taxi driver.

explain.text: 二選一問句，(A) 用「走路才五分鐘」暗示選走路。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: Can you tell me where the nearest bank is?
W: A. I deposited it already. B. Sure, it's across from the train station. C. The bank opens at nine.

explain.text: 問銀行在哪，(B) 給位置。(C) 雖然講到 bank，回答的卻是時間。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Mr. Lee is joining us for the client dinner, isn't he?
M: A. A table for six. B. The client called this morning. C. No, he has a prior commitment.

explain.text: 附加問句確認李先生會不會來，(C) 說他另有行程，所以不來。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: Which candidate did the committee choose?
W: A. They haven't announced it yet. B. The committee meets on Fridays. C. I'll choose the blue one.

explain.text: (A)「還沒公布」是「不知道」型的正確回應，多益常考。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Let's review the contract before we sign it.
M: A. Yes, the sign is outside. B. Good idea. I'll make copies. C. It was signed by the director.

explain.text: 對提議表示贊成並接著行動，(B) 正確。(A) 把 sign（簽名）換成 sign（招牌）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: How much will it cost to repair the air conditioner?
W: A. It's too hot in here. B. Since last summer. C. The technician will send us an estimate.

explain.text: 問價錢，(C)「技師會給報價」間接回答還不知道多少錢。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
W: Do you know if the parking garage is open on weekends?
M: A. I'm not sure. Let me check the website. B. Two dollars an hour. C. Yes, I parked it there.

explain.text: (A) 坦白說不確定、並說要去查，是合理回應。(B) 回答的是費用。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
questions.say:
M: Why don't we move the meeting to Thursday?
W: A. We met on Tuesday. B. The meeting room is upstairs. C. Sure, I'll let everyone know.

explain.text: Why don't we… 是提議，不是問原因；(C) 同意並說會通知大家。

questions.q: What is the woman trying to do?

explain.text: 她說要印四十份簡報，所以是要印文件。

questions.q: According to the man, what will happen on Thursday?
options: New key cards will be issued

explain.text: The technician isn't coming until Thursday——技師星期四才會來。

questions.q: What will the man probably do next?

explain.text: I'll call Jenny… 他要打電話給行銷部的 Jenny。

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
options: To change the start date of her reservation

explain.text: 她想把入住日從 12 號改成 11 號。

questions.q: What does the man say about the room available on the eleventh?
options: It does not have an ocean view
It is on the top floor

explain.text: it's a standard room, not an ocean-view room——不是海景房。

questions.q: What will the woman have to pay extra for?

explain.text: 機場接送要另收二十美元。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

explain.text: 整段在談產品發表會的準備。

questions.q: What caused the problem?

explain.text: 印刷廠的送貨卡車壞了（a delivery truck broke down）。題目把 truck 換成 vehicle。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
options: Prepare a digital version of the brochure
Print the brochures in the office

explain.text: could you prepare a digital version…——以防萬一準備電子版。

questions.q: Where most likely are the speakers?

explain.text: 第一句就說 joining this fitness center。

questions.q: Why does the man hesitate to choose the annual plan?
options: He does not like personal trainers
He already belongs to another gym

explain.text: 他半年後要因工作搬到別的城市；題目把 moving 換成 relocate。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man for?

explain.text: I'll just need to see a photo ID.

questions.q: What is the woman calling about?

explain.text: Half of the tomatoes were damaged.

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "we need those tomatoes for our lunch special"?
options: She wants to change the menu

explain.text: 午餐十一點半就開始，她是在暗示「很急」。這種「說這句話是什麼意思」是多益第三大題的固定題型。

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?

explain.text: 一小時內再送一箱過去，壞掉的不收錢（不是整張訂單退款）。

questions.q: Why is the man calling?

explain.text: we'd like to invite you for an interview.

questions.q: Why can't the woman come on Tuesday?

explain.text: I have a final exam that morning.

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to bring?

explain.text: examples of projects you've managed——過去做過的專案。

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?

explain.text: I'll be your guide today.

questions.q: What are listeners asked not to do?
options: Take pictures in a certain area

explain.text: taking photographs inside the production area is not permitted.

questions.q: What will listeners receive at the end of the tour?

explain.text: everyone will receive a free sample。禮品店打八五折是當天的折扣，不是發折價券。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the message?
options: To remind a patient about an appointment

explain.text: calling to remind you about your appointment.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the clinic?
options: It has moved to a new address

explain.text: We've recently moved to a new location.

questions.q: Why should the listener call in advance if he needs to reschedule?

explain.text: Otherwise, a cancellation fee may apply——不提前說會被收取消費。

questions.q: Why has the flight been delayed?

explain.text: heavy fog（濃霧）→ 題目改寫成 bad weather。

questions.q: What are passengers offered?

explain.text: a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars.

questions.q: Where should passengers go to receive the offer?
options: To any restaurant in Terminal B

explain.text: 到 22 號登機門旁的客服櫃台領；Terminal B 的餐廳是用券的地方，不是領券的地方。

questions.q: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A new system for travel expenses

explain.text: a new online system for submitting travel expenses.

questions.q: According to the speaker, what is an advantage of the change?
options: Paper forms will be easier to read

explain.text: 報帳從三週縮短成五個工作天。收據還是要拍照上傳，不是不用收據。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask some listeners to do?

explain.text: 需要出差的人一定要參加下週三的訓練。

questions.q: What is causing delays on Main Street?

explain.text: one lane is closed for road repairs——道路施工。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend that drivers do?

explain.text: Drivers are encouraged to use Park Avenue instead.

questions.q: What will happen on Saturday?

explain.text: the city's annual food festival begins this Saturday.
